name: Saber
source:
The servant of [url=/c3532]Leo Harway[/url]. He is a gallant knight, and unlike other servants, he reveals his name at the beginning of the story.

His true identity is Sir Gawain, the nephew of King Arthur and a Knight of the Round Table. [spoiler]His Noble Phantasm is called Excalibur Galatine.[/spoiler]
